title: pulse new
excerpt: Pulse now has its own newsroom — season updates, event recaps, and new-member announcements, published right here.
body:
Starting today, Pulse has a permanent home for everything happening across the community: event recaps, new committee announcements, scholarship news, and season milestones — published the way a real newsroom would, and kept forever in the archive.

This page updates automatically whenever the Pulse team publishes something new through the admin dashboard, so you never have to check anywhere else. Bookmark this page.

Got something the community should know about? Reach out to the Pulse Media Team.
author: Pulse Media Team

title: The Pulse of Physics: Exclusive Academic Sessions with Osama Hatem Farahat
excerpt: Pulse presents an exciting physics series for students conducted by Osama Hatem Farahat. Learn about the laws governing the universe and advanced concepts in applied physics.
body:
It is with great pleasure that Pulse introduces its unique academic series called "The Pulse of Physics" to help students connect theory with science in practice.
The series will be facilitated by Osama Hatem Farahat, the Head of the Olympiads Department at Pulse and student in Grade 12 at KFS STEM School, who accomplished the following among others:
Placing in the Top 15% globally in the International Physics Competition (IPhyC), and being an Official Ambassador of KFS STEM School.
Placing among the Top 20 globally in the 1st Edition of Pharos League.
Experience in applied physics through various engineering projects and Triboelectricity academic research.
Sessions Schedule and Details:
Girl's Session: Tuesday | 6:30 PM – 8:00 PM
Boy's Session: Wednesday | 6:30 PM – 8:00 PM
Place: Meeting Room
Where the Laws of the Universe meet your curiosity.
For more updates, visit our official website at pulsekfs.org or explore our Linktree at https://linktr.ee/pulsekfs.
author: Pulse Media Team

title: The Pulse of Impact: Exploring Voluntary Activities & Community Service
excerpt: Pulse invites you to an exciting session about the importance of volunteering and community engagement with Ali Abdelmoniem and Adham Mohamed Saad.
body:
🌟 We at Pulse are proud to bring you a special online session focusing on the amazing power of community service, grassroots activism, and social work! 🤝🌍

💡 Irrespective of whether you're interested in getting started on volunteer work or learning to launch successful campaigns yourself, this session will provide you with real life insights and practical advice on what it takes to be an agent of change. 🚀✨

🎯 Get to know the speakers:
🎖️ Ali Abdelmoniem: 2 years of active volunteering and social work with Resala STEM.
🎖️ Adham Mohamed Saad: 1 year of active involvement in humanitarian activities with the Egyptian Red Crescent.

📅 Session Details:
🗓️ Date: October 10, 2026
⏰ Time: 9:00 PM
📍 Venue: Online 💻

🌱 Be part of our journey towards making a difference in the world, acquiring great leadership skills, and leaving a mark for yourself in the community! 💙🔥
author: Pulse Media Team
